annotation.title_clean: Part 48—Registration and Marking Requirements for Small Unmanned Aircraft
annotation.title_en: Part 48—Registration and Marking Requirements for Small Unmanned Aircraft
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), U.S. Department of Transportation
annotation.venue: Code of Federal Regulations, 14 CFR Part 48
annotation.summary_en: US FAA regulation (14 CFR Part 48) requiring registration and marking of small unmanned aircraft. It sets eligibility, applicant information including remote ID serial numbers, fees, three-year renewal, update duties, and display of a unique identifier on the aircraft.
key_provisions_or_claims: Small unmanned aircraft must be registered with the FAA unless flown recreationally and weighing 0.55 lb or less, or military
Registration costs $5 and expires after 3 years unless renewed
Owners must update registration information within 14 days of changes
A unique identifier must be legibly displayed on an external surface of the aircraft
Applicants must supply remote identification serial numbers; only US citizens, permanent residents and certain entities are eligible
